description: DataCenter-Traces-Datasets publishes compact workload time series derived from the Alibaba 2018, Google 2019 and Azure v2 public traces. Fernández-Montes and Fernández Cerero at Universidad de Sevilla aggregate the original workloads for machine-learning and data-centre analysis. The inspected Zenodo version contains three CSV files at 300-second resolution. Alibaba variables describe average CPU, memory, network traffic and disk utilisation; Google variables are mean CPU, memory and cycles per instruction; Azure variables sum virtual-machine CPU and assigned memory. The repository additionally documents Alibaba series at 10 and 30 seconds, but those files are not in this inspected three-file Zenodo version. Coverage follows anonymised source clusters over eight days or approximately a month, with no geographic coordinates. Zenodo provides the data free under CC BY 4.0. The different means, sums and normalisations are a limitation when comparing providers, and aggregated workloads cannot reproduce individual-job scheduling. Simulation uses include coarse capacity planning and workload forecasting. Related records data-alibaba-cluster-trace-program, data-google-cluster-workload-traces and data-azure-public-dataset hold the original trace programmes; none explicitly covers this processed release.
